At some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="CSWE Hesoc" /> engaged the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the '''Matacorn campaign''' of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="HR" /> It shared its name with [[Matacorn]], a nondescript [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Matacorn system/Legends|Matacorn system]]</ref> At one [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engagement]] of the campaign, [[Hesoc]],<ref name="HR" /> an [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Alliance pilot]]<ref name="CSWE Hesoc" /> [[Pilot/Legends|flying]] an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]], eliminated eighteen [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and four [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] of the Empire. After that, however, an Imperial [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]<ref name="HR" /> shot Hesoc down<ref name="CSWE Hesoc" /> while he was executing a [[Tallon Roll/Legends|Tallon Roll]] maneuver.<ref name="HR" />

Hesoc brought his damaged [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] back in, but his right [[Limb/Legends|leg]] had been injured to the point where he was fitted with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthesis. Although such an injury would normally have meant an end to the pilot's flying career, Hesoc nevertheless managed to persuade the chain of [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] to reinstate him for combat duty.<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Matacorn campaign was introduced in "[["Irrefutable Logic"|Irrefutable Logic]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" />
